messages:
incident-bot: [PagerDuty] PAGER: gpu_vmem_pressure HIGH on pool-g4dn-04 region-us-west-2 -> paging oncall

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-789234 assigned to anya (oncall) — urgent

anya (oncall): acked PD-789234 - i'm on it, pinging infra and runtime

sam: seeing the same alerts - root cause looks like sudden kvcache spike + multiple long sequences, started ~6043199000

anya (oncall): can someone grab the logs for node gpu-7? run `curl http://logs.internal/gpu-7/recent | tail -n 100` and paste errors\\n

eng-shadow: paste from logs: ```
E CudaError: cuMemAlloc failed: out of memory (cuMemAllocRetry)
W KVCache: eviction rate spiked 18x
I Runtime: active seqs=275, avg_len=2140, max_len=12000
```

taylor: repro query patterns? any runaway user traffic?

cs-rep: CS: one enterprise customer (acme-inc) reported slow responses ~ 2m ago, they said they saw truncated outputs on chat tool

anya (oncall): ok customer impact probable — mark as potential degraded quality, notify CS to open support ticket if not already

sam: initiating soft-evict on pool-g4dn-04 to free kvcache: `rdctl pool evict --pool pool-g4dn-04 --percentage 20`

eng-shadow: suggested immediate mitigation: reroute new requests to fallback model variant with lower kv footprint (redwood/llama-2-7b-q4f)

anya (oncall): toggling routing policy to prefer fallback for autoscaling groups in us-west-2 now. command: `routes set-policy --region us-west-2 --policy fallback-low-kv`

pagerduty-bot: PD-789234 status: acknowledged, responders active

sam: started eviction, seeing memory reclaim on gpu-7, `/proc/gpu/mem` dropping from 98% -> 70% over 30s

taylor: are we safe to scale up more GPUs? we have capacity in us-east-1 but cross-region adds latency.

anya (oncall): prefer local mitigations first. if evict + fallback doesn't stabilize in 5m, we'll failover to us-east-1 and spin up dedicated nodes.

eng-shadow: note: there was a recent model rollout to pool-g4dn-04 with longer max_seq param; rollback could help too if this continues

sam: rollback in progress to config v2026-03-14-19: `deploy rollback pool-g4dn-04 --to v2026-03-14-19`

pagerduty-bot: PD-789234 update: escalation level unchanged, responders updating timeline

anya (oncall): CS, please message ACME that we're investigating; possible degraded quality for ~3-5 minutes and we have mitigation in progress. keep them updated. :thinking_face:

cs-rep: will do — pinged account team and opened support ticket #ACME-4521, they acknowledged

sam: after eviction + rollback, gpu mem steadying ~64%, KV evictions back to baseline. no more cuMemAlloc errors in latest 30s window

taylor: good sign. still seeing elevated latency for long-seq jobs though (p50 ok, p95 up 2x)

anya (oncall): placing short watch window 15m. leaving PD incident open until stable for 10m. if stable, we'll resolve with postmortem.

eng-shadow: quick note for postmortem: capture sequence length histogram, kvcache hit/miss by model version, and recent routing changes around 6043196000-6043200000

sam: also add: check autoscaler decisions for that pool during the spike (we saw no scale up despite queue growth)

anya (oncall): handoff to taylor for next 2h watch. i'll put details in incident ticket PD-789234 and hand off oncall. tagging @taylor

taylor: ack — taking over watch. will open a follow-up thread if anything regresses. nice quick triage team :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: PD-789234: acknowledged -> transferred to taylor. incident will remain open until manual resolve.

incident-bot: note: automated alert suppression triggered for same metric for 3m to reduce noise (auto-suppress-id: sup-1223)

anya (oncall): closing loop — create postmortem draft, include customer impact, mitigation steps, and action items: 1) limit rollout max_seq by pool, 2) autoscaler policy tweak to scale sooner, 3) KVCache admission control for very long sequences

cs-rep: ACME confirmed degraded experience but are ok with follow-up. will update ticket with timeline.
